content: Table TABREF26 presents results on NYT dataset. Following the same evaluation protocol as BIBREF36, we adopted the limited-length recall based ROUGE, where we truncated the predicted summaries to the length of the gold ones. Again, the first and second blocks show results of previous extractive and abstractive models, respectively. Results of Step are listed in the third block. Similar to the trends in CNNDM, Step leads significant performance gains (with $p<0.05$) compared to all other models in Table TABREF26.
